description.value: Fruition Farm Stand is a family-run roadside farm stand on the south end of Quadra Island, operated by the Greenland family since 2021, offering sustainably grown vegetables, small fruits (blueberries, raspberries, blackberries, cherries), garlic, and free-range eggs. The farm uses low- to no-till practices with no synthetic fertilizers or pesticides and has a completed Environmental Farm Plan. Cyclists exploring Quadra Island can stop at this working farm for a genuine local produce pickup just steps from the fields.
